review_locator: PMCID:PMC4791423, Role of Notch signaling in regulating innate immunity and inflammation in health and disease; PMCID:PMC5900058, Notch Signaling in Macrophages in the Context of Cancer Immunity
primary_title: Notch-RBP-J signaling regulates the transcription factor IRF8 to promote inflammatory macrophage polarization
decision_basis: The reviews identify canonical Notch-RBPJ as a regulator of IRF8 in inflammatory macrophages; the cited primary shows RBPJ-dependent TLR4/IRAK2/MNK1/eIF4E control of rapid IRF8 protein synthesis without requiring Irf8 mRNA induction.
limitations_preserved: RBPJ supports rapid IRF8 protein synthesis through a TLR4-linked translational mechanism; this is not RBPJ activation of the Irf8 gene, and the tonic Notch/macrophage context plus TLR trigger must remain explicit.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC9454819, IRF8: Mechanism of Action and Health Implications; PMCID:PMC3863528, Interferon-Regulatory Factors Determine Macrophage Phenotype Polarization
primary_title: IRF-8/ICSBP and IRF-1 cooperatively stimulate mouse IL-12 promoter activity in macrophages
decision_basis: The reviews identify cooperative IRF8/IRF1 control of IL-12p40 transcription; the cited primary shows synergistic activation of the murine Il12b promoter by IRF8 and IRF1 and loss of activation after mutation of the relevant ISRE-like element.
limitations_preserved: Direct cooperative promoter activation supports a bounded IRF8/IRF1-to-IL12B gene bridge; IL-12 protein assembly/secretion, additional NF-kappaB and C/EBP inputs, SCI relevance, and terminal-TF inference are not added.

review_locator: PMCID:PMC7915979, Microglia and Neuroinflammation: What Place for P2RY12?; PMCID:PMC9870594, Transcriptional and epigenetic regulation of microglia in maintenance of brain homeostasis and neurodegeneration
primary_title: IRF8 is a transcriptional determinant for microglial motility
decision_basis: The reviews identify P2RY12 as a microglial motility output and trace IRF8-dependent regulation; the cited primary shows Irf8-deficient microglia have suppressed P2ry12 expression and impaired ATP/C5a chemotaxis.
limitations_preserved: IRF8-dependent P2ry12 expression and microglial chemotaxis support a bounded expression/function edge, not direct IRF8 promoter occupancy; retain the microglial motility context and do not infer traumatic-SCI weighting or terminal-TF output.
